descriptionChirho: To seek someone or something earnestly, diligently, or early (with connotation of dawn/morning urgency); the primary Piel usage of שָׁחַר covering all inflected forms — finite verbs, infinitives, and participles — used of seeking God, wisdom, or disciplining diligently.
Qal participle form of שָׁחַר denoting one who diligently seeks; a rare stem variant (hapax) with meaning essentially synonymous to the Piel but distinguished by verbal stem.
